profile.summary: A nonprofit in Oakland, California that works with families to support children's learning. Its programs include the REACH Parent District, which offers virtual reading tutoring and family success coaching, and a model that trains parents and caregivers to serve as tutors in schools. It also advocates on public education issues.

review.notes: Oakland Reach is an Oakland-based 501(c)(3) education and advocacy nonprofit (ProPublica, EIN 83-1289590) that runs tutoring and family programs and works with OUSD, which fits a no-cost services and data sharing agreement with the Special Education Department. The summary, EIN, address, phone and generic info@ email are all supported by the fetched pages.
